paragraphs: SiFi Networks funds, builds and operates open access fiber networks across the US. Those networks are built citywide and connect homes and businesses. Retail service over them is provided by third-party internet service providers rather than by SiFi Networks.

Separate entry points on the homepage address residents, municipalities, service providers and investors. For internet service providers, the FiberCity offer is a citywide customer footprint without CAPEX. For investors, fiber infrastructure is described as delivering long-term returns.
The homepage describes 10 gig enabled fiber networks that close the digital divide.

quote.text: Our FiberCity ® networks provide a citywide customer footprint without CAPEX.
